theme: A quiet Sunday in the city — one booking to close, then dinner.
greeting: The board review is behind you and the evening opens at Misi, Dan. The one open thread is the last Dubrovnik night — Mike is waiting on the Cavtat booking before it slips.

needsAttention.title: Last Dubrovnik night still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, flagged p1 and due today: book the single night of Sept 19 in Cavtat near the airport, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am flight out. Mike is waiting on this one.

needsAttention.title: Appointment with Mike, arrive by 1:45
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 1:45 PM appointment with Mike at HSS on the Upper East Side needs a firm arrival time — leave enough runway from wherever the morning starts.

recipe.title: Poached Peaches
recipe.why: Peaches are at their late-summer peak right now, so poach the ripest and let the season carry the dish.

acts.line: The 15-minute board review with Mike squared away the week.
An open stretch in the city with nothing on the calendar.
Dinner at Misi at 6:45 closes the day.
